answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fakes. Each identity stakes 70 and pays 60 per epoch in tax; the shale ledger records each payment. A raven auditor samples receipts at random, exposing receipt-sharing rings that reuse one payment for many keys; rewards voided, bonds burned. Across the ocean of operations, 1,000 fakes pay 60,000 in tax and risk 70,000 in bonds against a 40,000 pool, a sure loss; honest agents pay 60 once and keep full share.
